name: Université Paris-Saclay (Orsay / Hadamard)
header:
Université Paris-Saclay (Orsay / Hadamard)
France · M1 Jacques Hadamard or Mathématiques fondamentales; M2 Analysis, Arithmetic, Geometry; later EDMH doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Sophie Germain funding closes before most academic deadlines and has a separate letter deadline.
• INCEPTION references must be received before final application validation; SG invitations are sent after
validation.
• M2 admission requires M1-equivalent knowledge; UChicago BA equivalence is not automatic.
• Ordinary M1 fundamentals French requirements differ from Hadamard English route.
• Schraen former Orsay page redirects to Lyon; excluded from current Orsay shortlist.
• Public university PhD Track 2027 targets current M1/engineering students; no entering bachelor’s funding
promise.
• Saclay’s INCEPTION-first/EEF-after-admission route differs from Sorbonne and Strasbourg. PGSM’s listed Paris
partners do not include Paris-Saclay; use Sophie Germain/IDEX routes instead.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s is a plausible M1-equivalent entry qualification subject to committee
evaluation; M1 fundamental mathematics asks L3/equivalent. M2 AAG needs mathematical knowledge
equivalent to fundamental-math M1; a four-year US BA is not automatically certified as M1/240 ECTS. Direct
doctoral entry with only the BA is not established: EDMH evaluates master-level preparation, a specific
supervisor/topic and three years of funding. Ask whether exceptional advanced BA coursework permits M2
placement. [s2] [s3] [s8] [s13] [s15]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Determine M1 versus M2 and teaching language. For a non-European national resident in an Études-en-France
country, Saclay instructs INCEPTION first, then EEF “I am accepted” after admission; nationality/residence
determine the route. Apply separately to Sophie Germain and the academic programme. Doctorate: agree
project and funding with a supervisor before ADUM. No supervisor commitment required for M1. [s5] [s8] [s13]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For M1 contact Frédéric Rousset about placement/English plan; M2 AAG directors Emanuele Macrì and Thibault
Lefeuvre. For doctorate first establish thesis director, topic and three-year funding; supervisor/lab approval is
necessary. The shortlist focuses Orsay; IP Paris and IHES are distinct institutions within the larger doctoral
ecosystem. [s9] [s10] [s13] [s36]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
INCEPTION: PDF under 3 MB, unprotected; one transcript file; up to seven programme applications submitted
separately; no post. Applicants without French INE select first registration. Submission requires validation.
ADUM doctorate requires complete dossier and supervisor/lab approval. [s4] [s36]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit 2027 Sophie Germain and university PhD Track found. M1/M2 academic, IDEX and main EDMH funding
dates remain 2026 only. Do not substitute adjacent-year schedules. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s11] [s16] [s19]

sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Hadamard offers a coherent English curriculum for non-French speakers; M2 AAG switches to English whenever
a non-French speaker attends. M1 fundamental is primarily French and lists French proof mandatory for
non-French speakers, despite placing it in the optional category. No TOEFL/IELTS threshold published in these
course checklists; general language requirements depend on programme. [s2] [s4] [s7] [s10]

competence. Confirm chosen Hadamard English course plan and whether proof of English is requested. [s1] [s4]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Conflict]
Prepare two academic referees for INCEPTION international admission: central instructions say two when
requested; programme pages label letters additional/recommended. International page mandates two for
first-time foreign applicants but retains stale academic-year examples. Sophie Germain guidance says two;
form marks referee 1 required and referee 2 unstarred - supply two. EDMH permits two confidential referees
plus supervisor/lab support. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s8] [s14]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain separate referee submission (two recommended by call), not automatic admission-letter
reuse. IDEX may request two referee questionnaires after nomination. EDMH needs detailed
intended-supervisor support and laboratory opinion in addition to optional confidential referee letters. [s5] [s11]
[s14]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
INCEPTION: contact details trigger an emailed procedure, before final validation; exact save/send button not
specified publicly. Sophie Germain explicitly sends automatic invitations only when the scholarship application
is validated. EDMH: use the referee-request option and enter emails; invitations then go out. [s4] [s5] [s14]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Admission INCEPTION letters precede final application validation. Sophie Germain letters follow
validation/submission. These are separate portals with opposite sequencing. [s4] [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
INCEPTION personal space shows submission progress without letter text; email when both complete. IDEX
sends receipt confirmations, without revealing recommendation. Sophie Germain applicant receipt display not
documented. [s4] [s11]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
INCEPTION allows one referee replacement, one email correction and one reminder; application locked after

validation, unless jury reopens. Letter revision/reuse not specified. Sophie Germain and ADUM
reuse/replacement rules unresolved. [s4]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required for academic M1/M2, Sophie Germain and EDMH. Admission PDF under 3 MB, no published CV page
limit. EDMH CV includes nationality, birth date, contact information and master research/internship
descriptions and supervisors. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s6] [s14]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
M1/M2 motivation letter required; no word/page limit published. Address jury president and name programme;
upload PDF under 3 MB. Faithful doctoral prompt paraphrase: explain academic background and reasons for
the particular thesis. Included in combined doctoral PDF. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s14]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay in academic checklists. Sophie Germain two-page study plan may
explain unusual CV/transcript circumstances. [s1] [s3] [s5]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain study/research plan required; academic M1/M2 no separately named research-interest
document. Doctoral project requires explicit research context and programme. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s14]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
EDMH: project title and 15-line summary in BOTH French and English; funding type, host unit, supervisors,
doctoral school/institution; then maximum five pages on context, outlook and work plan. Include in single PDF
with cover page identifying applicant, thesis title and all funding calls. This is for later doctoral entry, not
ordinary M1 admission. [s14]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
M2 AAG allows an additional document of the applicant’s choice; no specified sample length. Public M1
checklists do not establish a thesis/paper requirement. No rule found allowing links in place of required
uploaded PDFs. [s1] [s3]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No distinct publications-list requirement in academic or scholarship checklists. EDMH research history may be
included in CV; extra paper upload/link policy unverified. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s14]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Use academic-record/course-description requirements above. M2 external course-unit detail is separate from
research prose; no exact template/length located. [s2] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain: maximum two-page study plan, faithful paraphrase - introduce yourself, expectations from
graduate study, mathematical interests/career aims and unusual record context. Upload; font/spacing
unspecified. Live form also optional awards upload and optional second master choice. IDEX full essay lengths
not public. University PhD Track: three-page maximum PDF on project/motivation, research themes, Saclay
internship teams/potential PhD, plus short summary; English/French. [s5] [s6] [s19]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
EDMH interdisciplinary funding: add relevant FMJH theme and paragraph on interdisciplinarity, with supervisor
emphasis; cotutelle proposal should specify stay schedule. ADUM motivation/additional-info boxes need not be
completed separately when contents are in combined PDF. [s14]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain: €11,000 net/year plus registration-cost allowance; first-time international travel/visa
allowance up to €2,000 and studio reservation/housing kit approximately €100. Reservation does not state free
rent. IDEX 2026: €10,000 over ten instalments September-June plus up to €900 yearly travel/visa; no tuition
coverage or housing guarantee. EDMH exact annual 2027 salary not established; obtain written gross/net
contract amount. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain published annual amount; automatic M1-to-M2 renewal not established. IDEX: one M2 year or
two years from M1, contingent credits and admission to Saclay M2; repeating a year ends award. Doctorate
requires three years of funding. Extensions may be separately requested, not guaranteed. [s7] [s12] [s13]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain admits students worldwide and UChicago is outside the Saclay perimeter. IDEX: foreign
nationality, first enrolment in France (limited exchange/internship exceptions), under 30; these personal facts
need checking. EDMH welcomes international recruitment. Maryam Mirzakhani master-to-PhD awards target
women; do not assume John eligible. [s5] [s7] [s11] [s13]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Sophie Germain cannot combine with another excellence award. IDEX excludes other support above
€600/month and named excellence programmes; no advance before French arrival/registration; no
deferral/programme change; unpaid gaps and some outside-Saclay/international study or internships
reduce/suspend payment. Academic attendance and progress required. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Separate academic and scholarship applications mandatory. IDEX requires admission plus coordinator
nomination and emailed link; it is not open direct self-nomination. EDMH via ADUM includes funding choices,
supervisor validation and lab opinion. University PhD Track requires prior Graduate School contact and
selective interview. [s5] [s11] [s19] [s20]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
EDMH lists ministerial/Graduate School white-project contracts, FMJH, MathPhDinFrance cotutelles, and
supervisor ANR/ERC/CIFRE funding. University PhD Track is a later potential route for current M1 students; no
guarantee for entering 2027 BA applicants. Master mobility grants support internships. [s9] [s13] [s17] [s19]
Application fee [Unresolved]
Application charge not established from public course/INCEPTION pages. Tuition is separate: central page only
gives 2025/26 national master €254 and doctorate €397; 2027 not published. Non-EU partial exemption can
reduce differentiated tuition to national rate under a 2026 resolution. Budget CVEC separately; 2027 amount
not established. For eligible US-resident applicants admitted through INCEPTION and then using EEF “I am
accepted,” regular Campus France pre-consular processing is US$270; the US$460 full-admissions route is
different. [s4] [s18] [s38] [s39]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No application-fee waiver procedure located. Tuition exemptions may be statutory or individually approved;
2027 process unposted. IDEX does not pay tuition; laureates may request discretionary reduction. [s12] [s18]

Université Paris-Saclay (Orsay / Hadamard)
France · M1 Jacques Hadamard or Mathématiques fondamentales; M2 Analysis, Arithmetic, Geometry; later EDMH doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Sophie Germain funding closes before most academic deadlines and has a separate letter deadline.
• INCEPTION references must be received before final application validation; SG invitations are sent after
validation.
• M2 admission requires M1-equivalent knowledge; UChicago BA equivalence is not automatic.
• Ordinary M1 fundamentals French requirements differ from Hadamard English route.
• Schraen former Orsay page redirects to Lyon; excluded from current Orsay shortlist.
• Public university PhD Track 2027 targets current M1/engineering students; no entering bachelor’s funding
promise.
• Saclay’s INCEPTION-first/EEF-after-admission route differs from Sorbonne and Strasbourg. PGSM’s listed Paris
partners do not include Paris-Saclay; use Sophie Germain/IDEX routes instead.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s is a plausible M1-equivalent entry qualification subject to committee
evaluation; M1 fundamental mathematics asks L3/equivalent. M2 AAG needs mathematical knowledge
equivalent to fundamental-math M1; a four-year US BA is not automatically certified as M1/240 ECTS. Direct
doctoral entry with only the BA is not established: EDMH evaluates master-level preparation, a specific
supervisor/topic and three years of funding. Ask whether exceptional advanced BA coursework permits M2
placement. [s2] [s3] [s8] [s13] [s15]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Determine M1 versus M2 and teaching language. For a non-European national resident in an Études-en-France
country, Saclay instructs INCEPTION first, then EEF “I am accepted” after admission; nationality/residence
determine the route. Apply separately to Sophie Germain and the academic programme. Doctorate: agree
project and funding with a supervisor before ADUM. No supervisor commitment required for M1. [s5] [s8] [s13]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For M1 contact Frédéric Rousset about placement/English plan; M2 AAG directors Emanuele Macrì and Thibault
Lefeuvre. For doctorate first establish thesis director, topic and three-year funding; supervisor/lab approval is
